_about: Written by tools/courses.py: edit that and run it, not this. The five holes in the order a round plays them. Lengths in centimetres; x is to the right of the tee and z toward it (the lotus is at negative z). bounds: x0, z0, x1, z1. base: the ground's height before shapes; rough: a seeded unevenness's height and scale. hazard: [kind, level] over the whole hole. waters: rivers (line: x0, z0, x1, z1, width) and ponds (disc: x, z, radius) at a level, water or lava; the core cuts each one's bed into the ground. falls: x, z, top, bottom, width, heading. hills and plateaus: [x, z, radius, height]; mesas: [x, z, radius, height, cliff]; ridges: [x0, z0, x1, z1, radius, height]; benches: flat-topped terraces [x0, z0, x1, z1, width, height, cliff]. tunnels: a rock roof over a cut along z [x, z0, z1, width, clearance, thickness]. fairways: [x0, z0, x1, z1, width]. paints: a theme paint along a line. pads: lily pads [x, z, radius]. webs: set into the ground over a pit [x, z, radius]. mushrooms: explosive [x, z]. bumpers: giant blue mushrooms [x, z, cap radius, cap height]. items: [jump or wings, x, z]. bubbles: [x, z, height, points]. flies: lines [x0, z0, x1, z1, how many, height, arc]; shot_flies: along the arc a shot flies [x0, z0, toward x, toward z, power, how many]. snails: [x0, z0, x1, z1, speed cm/s, size]. antlions: [x, z, radius]. whirlpools: [x, z, radius]. props and scatter: scenery. buildings: [x0, z0, x1, z1, height]. lanes: cars along z between two x.
